You Just Had To Be There

Some social phenomena were best enjoyed as they were happening.<br> Jumping into the phenomena after it happened is a lot like readng the bible; The events were probably crazy as they were happening, but now it is just a static text.<br> Consider Homestuck in 2011. It was a cultural phenomenon, with its fandom doing insane things on a daily basis.<br> Readers would obsess over the comic, with update notifiers on their websites activating every 6 hours. https://mspanotify.tumblr.com/<br> You just had to be there.

Below originally written on July 04, 2024.

List of the most intense childhood and teenage fads in order of importance: Pokemon Pokemania, 1999<br> Pokemon Go, 2016 Summer Minecraft, 2011

Honourable mentions not in order: Homestuck, 2011<br> Fortnite, 2018<br> Roblox, Present
